title: Sinusoid
text: Model DC offset and sinusoidal modulation, {Offset in-phase} sets In-phase offset 0; {Source type} sets the wave type Ideal, {Offset quadrature} sets the quadrature offset, {Sinusoidal amplitude in-phase} sets the in-phase amplitude, {Sinusoidal amplitude quadrature} sets the quadrature amplitude, {Sinusoidal modulation frequency} sets the modulation frequency, {Time delay}, {Carrier frequencies} and {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground RF circuit terminals. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Source type
params.values: Wave type Ideal voltage (default) | Ideal current

params.name: Offset in-phase
params.values: In-phase offset 0 V (default) | 0 A | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Offset quadrature
params.values: Quadrature offset 0 V (default) | 0 A | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Sinusoidal amplitude in-phase
params.values: In-phase amplitude 0 (default) | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Sinusoidal amplitude quadrature
params.values: Quadrature amplitude 0 (default) | vector of real or complex numbers | V | mV | kV | A | mA | uA | kA

params.name: Sinusoidal modulation frequency
params.values: Modulation frequency 0 (default) | vector of real or complex numbers | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Time delay
params.values: Time delay of modulation 0 (default) | vector of real | s | ms | us | ns

params.name: Carrier frequencies
params.values: Carrier frequencies 0 (default) | vector of real positive numbers | Hz | kHz | MHz | GHz

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: Ground RF circuit terminals on (default) | off
